filesystem.allocation_note: Root and directory allocations deduplicate hard links by device/inode. APFS clone/shared extents are not identified; unlinked open read-only cache images are conservatively represented by vnode-length upper bounds; post-cleanup df is authoritative.
filesystem.project_scope_note: FG-Metal project budget excludes DXMT/FrameGen path components; these workstreams remain inventoried and protected from deletion.
